description: Flat record-level metadata for saliva-derived human genomic sequencing from diverse populations intended for disease susceptibility and common-variant analysis.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record corresponding to one sequenced participant/sample. Example: 'PGS000123'.

participant_id.descr: Stable de-identified participant identifier used across linked study tables. Example: 'P001245'.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the biological sample used for sequencing. Example: 'SMP-77881'.

family_id.descr: Optional pedigree or family identifier if participants are related; use null or empty if unrelated.

study_site_id.descr: Identifier for the recruitment or collection site. Example: 'SITE_03'.

collection_country.descr: Country where the participant was recruited or the sample was collected. Use ISO country name or code consistently.

collection_region.descr: Subnational region, province, state, or district of recruitment/collection; useful for geographic stratification.

population_group.descr: Reported population group or cohort label used in the study, preferably using controlled terminology where possible.

ethnic_group.descr: Self-reported ethnic group category, as collected in the study questionnaire or consent form.

ancestry_category.descr: Genetic or inferred ancestry category used in analysis, such as 'African', 'European', 'East Asian', 'South Asian', 'Admixed'.

self_reported_sex.descr: Participant self-reported sex or sex assigned at birth, depending on study design; use controlled categories.

gender_identity.descr: Self-reported gender identity if collected. Example values may include 'woman', 'man', 'nonbinary', or study-specific categories.

date_of_birth.descr: Participant date of birth, if permitted and collected; otherwise use a derived age field and omit this value.

age_at_enrollment_years.descr: Age at enrollment or consent in years. Use decimal values if needed for months.

age_at_sample_collection_years.descr: Age at the time of saliva sample collection in years.

consent_obtained.descr: Whether informed consent was obtained from the participant prior to sample collection.

consent_form_version.descr: Version identifier of the consent form or leaflet used. Example: 'v2.1'.

consent_date.descr: Date on which informed consent was signed or recorded.

consent_leaflet_version.descr: Version identifier of the participant information leaflet or detailed study leaflet provided during consent.

broad_genomic_sharing_consent.descr: Whether the participant consented to controlled or broad sharing of de-identified genomic data for research reuse.

commercial_use_restriction.descr: Whether the consent included restrictions on commercial use of the data or samples.

recontact_allowed.descr: Whether the participant allowed future recontact for follow-up studies or additional consent.

sample_type.descr: Biological sample source. For this study typically 'saliva'.

sample_collection_date.descr: Date on which the saliva sample was collected.

sample_collection_method.descr: Method or kit used for saliva collection, if applicable.

sample_storage_condition.descr: Storage condition prior to DNA extraction, such as temperature or preservative used.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction protocol, kit, or laboratory method used to isolate DNA from saliva.

dna_yield_ng.descr: Total DNA yield from extraction in nanograms (ng).

dna_concentration_ng_per_ul.descr: DNA concentration in nanograms per microliter (ng/µL).

dna_purity_a260_a280.descr: DNA purity ratio measured by absorbance at 260/280 nm.

dna_integrity_metric.descr: Optional DNA integrity metric such as DIN, RIN-like score, or fragment quality measure.

library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used before sequencing.

library_insert_size_bp.descr: Average or target insert size in base pairs (bp).

library_pcr_cycles.descr: Number of PCR amplification cycles used during library preparation.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used, such as Illumina NovaSeq, HiSeq, or equivalent.

sequencing_center.descr: Laboratory or facility where sequencing was performed.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier for the sequencing run or lane associated with the record.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy used, such as whole-genome sequencing, whole-exome sequencing, or targeted panel.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs per read, for example 150 for paired-end 150 bp.

library_layout.descr: Read layout of the sequencing library, such as single-end or paired-end.

average_coverage_x.descr: Mean sequencing depth of coverage across callable genome regions, reported as X-fold coverage.

genome_coverage_fraction.descr: Fraction of the target or callable genome covered at the desired minimum depth.

mapped_read_percentage.descr: Percentage of reads that successfully mapped to the reference genome.

duplicate_read_percentage.descr: Percentage of duplicate reads removed or marked during processing.

insert_size_mean_bp.descr: Mean observed insert size in base pairs, if available.

reference_genome_build.descr: Reference genome assembly used for alignment and variant calling, such as GRCh37 or GRCh38.

alignment_tool.descr: Software used for read alignment, for example BWA-MEM or Bowtie2.

variant_calling_pipeline.descr: Pipeline or software package used for small-variant calling.

variant_calling_version.descr: Version of the variant calling pipeline/software.

variant_filtering_method.descr: Post-calling filtering strategy used, such as hard filters, VQSR, or custom QC thresholds.

common_variant_focus.descr: Whether the analysis is primarily focused on common genetic variants rather than rare variants or structural variants.

num_snvs_called.descr: Number of single-nucleotide variants called for this record after QC, if applicable.

num_indels_called.descr: Number of insertion-deletion variants called for this record after QC, if applicable.

genotype_missing_rate.descr: Proportion of missing genotype calls across evaluated loci, expressed from 0 to 1.

hardy_weinberg_qc_pass.descr: Whether variant-level or sample-level Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium QC criteria were met, if assessed.

relatedness_checked.descr: Whether relatedness or kinship was evaluated for the participant/sample.

relatedness_metric.descr: Numeric relatedness or kinship metric, if calculated.

phenotype_case_control_status.descr: Disease status used in analysis, such as 'case', 'control', 'unknown', or cohort-specific labels.

primary_disease_trait.descr: Primary disease or trait studied for susceptibility analysis, using a controlled term if possible.

comorbid_conditions.descr: Additional diagnosed conditions reported for the participant, preferably semicolon-separated if multiple.

phenotype_ascertainment_method.descr: How disease status or phenotype was determined, such as self-report, clinical record, ICD code, or physician diagnosis.

diagnosis_date.descr: Date of primary disease diagnosis, if applicable and collected.

phenotype_age_onset_years.descr: Age at onset of the primary disease or trait in years, if known.

medication_use_related_to_trait.descr: Whether the participant was taking medication relevant to the studied disease trait at collection time.

smoking_status.descr: Smoking exposure category if collected, such as never, former, current, or unknown.

alcohol_use_status.descr: Alcohol use category if collected, such as never, former, current, or unknown.

body_mass_index.descr: Body mass index (BMI) in kg/m^2, if collected.

blood_pressure_systolic_mmHg.descr: Systolic blood pressure in millimeters of mercury (mmHg), if collected.

blood_pressure_diastolic_mmHg.descr: Diastolic blood pressure in millimeters of mercury (mmHg), if collected.

data_deidentification_level.descr: Degree of de-identification applied to the record, such as fully de-identified, pseudonymized, or limited identifiers retained.

data_sharing_allowed.descr: Whether the data record may be shared according to consent and governance rules.

access_level.descr: Data access category, such as open, controlled, embargoed, or restricted.

embargo_end_date.descr: Date until which the record remains under embargo before release or sharing, if applicable.

qc_pass.descr: Whether the sample and sequencing record passed study-defined quality control thresholds.

qc_notes.descr: Free-text notes describing QC issues, exclusions, protocol deviations, or unusual observations.
